"""The file test: cases.json in, result dict out.

The one function behind both `./run --input ... --output ...` and the web app's
"Test a file" page, which runs this same file in the browser with Pyodide.
Keep its imports inside BROWSER_FILES so the browser copy stays complete.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from .core import BUILT_FOR, run
from .sources import file as file_source

# Everything run_file needs, relative to the repo root. The web app ships exactly these files.
BROWSER_FILES = [
    "brightloop/__init__.py",
    "brightloop/file_run.py",
    "brightloop/core/__init__.py",
    "brightloop/core/normalize.py",
    "brightloop/core/pipeline.py",
    "brightloop/core/pricing.py",
    "brightloop/core/trust.py",
    "brightloop/sources/__init__.py",
    "brightloop/sources/file.py",
]


def run_file(input_path: str) -> dict:
    payload, load_errors = file_source.load(input_path)
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    try:
        result = run(payload, started_at=started)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - a bug must still leave a valid result file
        result = _fallback(payload, started, exc)
    result["run"]["errors"][:0] = load_errors
    result["run"]["mode"] = "file"
    return result


def _fallback(payload: object, started: datetime, exc: Exception) -> dict:
    """The output contract even when the decision code itself fails: every id the input gave is
    placed in skipped, so nothing disappears, and the failure is stated in run.errors."""
    ids: list[str] = []
    signals = payload.get("signals") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
    for s in signals if isinstance(signals, list) else []:
        sid = s.get("id") if isinstance(s, dict) else None
        if isinstance(sid, (int, float)) and not isinstance(sid, bool):
            sid = str(sid)
        if isinstance(sid, str) and sid.strip() and sid not in ids:
            ids.append(sid)
    reason = "Not processed: the run stopped on an internal error (see run.errors)."
    return {
        "built_for": BUILT_FOR,
        "items": [],
        "skipped": [{"id": sid, "reason": reason} for sid in ids],
        "run": {"started_at": started.isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "cost_usd": 0.0,
                "errors": [f"Internal error: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"]},
    }

"""The one decision path. Live runs and file runs both end up here.

Input: the cases.json shape (week, timezone, brand, config, signals).
Output: the required wrapper (built_for, items, skipped, run).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo, ZoneInfoNotFoundError

from .normalize import clean_text, iso_utc, parse_ts, slug, week_bounds
from .pricing import PROMO, Change, find_change, states_no_change
from .trust import OFFICIAL_OTHER, THIRD_PARTY, SourceInfo, classify_source

BUILT_FOR = "maya"

# Confidence is computed from the evidence, never read from the input.
# Only the competitor's own pricing page can produce an item, so it's the base.
PRICING_PAGE_CONFIDENCE = 0.9
NUMBERS_BONUS = 0.05       # before and after values both stated
CORROBORATION_BONUS = 0.04  # per extra independent domain reporting the same change
INJECTION_PENALTY = 0.2    # the text tried to instruct an AI; trust it less
PACKAGING_PENALTY = 0.15   # a feature line moved but no number changed; worth a look, less certain
MAX_CONFIDENCE = 0.99

# Two reports of the same change (same competitor, plan, field and new value) this close
# together are one change, so Maya gets one slide, not two.
SAME_CHANGE_WINDOW = timedelta(days=7)

_RUMOR = re.compile(
    r"\?\?|\b(heard|rumou?rs?|allegedly|reportedly|unconfirmed|word is|apparently|might be|could be)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


@dataclass
class _Candidate:
    sid: str
    competitor: str
    change: Change
    text: str  # visible text only, hidden comments already removed
    source: str
    info: SourceInfo
    ts: datetime | None
    injected: bool
    screenshot: str | None = None  # set by live runs: the cropped plan card


@dataclass
class _Group:
    members: list[_Candidate] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def first(self) -> _Candidate:
        return self.members[0]


def _change_key(c: _Candidate) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    ch = c.change
    return (slug(c.competitor), ch.field, (ch.plan or "").lower(), (ch.after or ch.quote).lower())


def _close_in_time(a: datetime | None, b: datetime | None) -> bool:
    return a is None or b is None or abs(a - b) <= SAME_CHANGE_WINDOW


def _summary(competitor: str, ch: Change) -> str:
    plan = f" {ch.plan}" if ch.plan else ""
    if ch.field == "tier":
        return f"{competitor}: {ch.quote.rstrip('.')}"
    if ch.field == "plan":
        return f"{competitor}: new {ch.plan} plan at {ch.after}"
    if ch.field == "packaging":
        if ch.before and ch.after:
            return f"{competitor}{plan}: '{ch.before}' is now '{ch.after}'"
        if ch.after:
            return f"{competitor}{plan}: '{ch.after}' added"
        if ch.before:
            return f"{competitor}{plan}: '{ch.before}' removed"
        return f"{competitor}{plan}: {ch.quote.rstrip('.')}"
    if ch.before and ch.after:
        bare = ch.before.replace(",", "").replace(".", "").isdigit()
        unit = f" {ch.field}" if bare and ch.field != "price" else ""
        return f"{competitor}{plan}: {ch.before}{unit} → {ch.after}{unit}"
    if ch.after:
        return f"{competitor}{plan}: price {'raised' if ch.direction == 'up' else 'cut'} to {ch.after}"
    return f"{competitor}{plan}: packaging change (\"{ch.quote}\")"


_NUM = re.compile(r"\d[\d,.]*")
_BARE = re.compile(r"\d[\d,.]*[KM]?")


def _deck_line(ch: Change) -> str:
    """Maya's red box, as she writes it: short. "Pro: $25→$30/month", "Free: 5→3 projects"."""
    prefix = f"{ch.plan}: " if ch.plan else ""
    b, a = ch.before, ch.after
    if ch.field == "plan":
        return f"New {ch.plan} plan: {a}"
    if ch.field in ("tier", "packaging") or not (b and a):
        return _summary("", ch).lstrip(" :")
    if ch.field == "price":
        (b_amt, _, b_per), (a_amt, _, a_per) = b.partition("/"), a.partition("/")
        if b_per == a_per:
            return f"{prefix}{b_amt}→{a_amt}" + (f"/{a_per}" if a_per else "")
        return f"{prefix}{b}→{a}"
    if _BARE.fullmatch(b) and _BARE.fullmatch(a):  # bare quantities: "5" → "3" projects, "10M" → "5M" tokens
        return f"{prefix}{b}→{a} {ch.field}"
    nb, na = _NUM.findall(b), _NUM.findall(a)
    if len(nb) == len(na) == 1 and _NUM.sub("#", b) == _NUM.sub("#", a):  # "100 monthly credits" → "50 …"
        return f"{prefix}{_NUM.sub(f'{nb[0]}→{na[0]}', a, count=1)}"
    return f"{prefix}{b}→{a}"


def _scrub(text: str, banned: list[str]) -> str:
    for word in banned:
        text = re.sub(re.escape(word), "[removed]", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return text


def _build_item(group: _Group, used_ids: set[str], week: str, utm_source: str, banned: list[str]) -> dict:
    # Lead with the earliest report.
    members = sorted(group.members, key=lambda c: (c.ts is None, iso_utc(c.ts) or ""))
    lead = members[0]
    ch, comp = lead.change, lead.competitor
    domains = {m.info.domain for m in members if m.info.domain}

    confidence = PRICING_PAGE_CONFIDENCE
    if ch.has_numbers:
        confidence += NUMBERS_BONUS
    confidence += CORROBORATION_BONUS * max(0, len(domains) - 1)
    if any(m.injected for m in members):
        confidence -= INJECTION_PENALTY
    if ch.field == "packaging":
        confidence -= PACKAGING_PENALTY
    confidence = round(min(MAX_CONFIDENCE, max(0.0, confidence)), 2)

    summary = _summary(comp, ch)
    action = (f"Add a slide to Monday's deck: {summary}, with a screenshot of {lead.source}. "
              f"Then update the Brightloop vs {comp} comparison page.")
    if ch.direction == "up":
        action += (f" Price went up: check whether Brightloop is now cheaper on this plan; "
                   f"if it is, that's a 'cheaper than {comp}' angle for Daniel.")
    elif ch.direction == "down":
        action += f" Price went down: re-check any 'cheaper than {comp}' claims in our ads and pages."

    seen_on = ", ".join(dict.fromkeys(m.source for m in members if m.source)) or "an unnamed source"
    why = (f"{summary}, stated on {seen_on} ({iso_utc(lead.ts) or 'time not given'}). "
           f"Source is the competitor's own pricing page, with the numbers next to it.")
    if len(domains) > 1:
        why += f" {len(domains)} independent sources report the same change."
    if any(m.injected for m in members):
        why += " One source contained hidden instructions aimed at AI systems; they were ignored."

    base_id = f"chg-{slug(comp)}-{slug(ch.plan or 'all')}-{slug(ch.field)}-{slug(ch.after or 'change')}"
    item_id, n = base_id, 2
    while item_id in used_ids:
        item_id, n = f"{base_id}-{n}", n + 1
    used_ids.add(item_id)

    campaign = f"{week.lower()}-{slug(comp)}-pricing" if week else f"{slug(comp)}-pricing"
    return {
        "id": item_id,
        "source_ids": [m.sid for m in members],
        "confidence": confidence,
        "action": _scrub(action, banned),
        "why": _scrub(why, banned),
        "competitor": comp,
        # Maya's red text box on the competitor's slide, e.g. "Pro: $20/month → $25/month".
        "deck_line": _scrub(_deck_line(ch), banned),
        "change": {"field": ch.field, "plan": ch.plan, "before": ch.before, "after": ch.after,
                   "direction": ch.direction},
        "evidence": [{"source_id": m.sid, "source": m.source, "ts_utc": iso_utc(m.ts),
                      "quote": m.text, "source_tier": m.info.tier,
                      **({"screenshot": m.screenshot} if m.screenshot else {})} for m in members],
        "cta": {"label": f"Review the {comp} pricing change",
                "utm": f"utm_source={utm_source}&utm_medium=pricing_deck&utm_campaign={campaign}"},
    }


def run(payload: object, *, started_at: datetime) -> dict:
    errors: list[str] = []
    notes: list[str] = []  # not failures, worth knowing (run.notes, only when there are any)
    skipped: list[dict] = []
    out = {"built_for": BUILT_FOR, "items": [], "skipped": skipped,
           "run": {"started_at": started_at.isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "cost_usd": 0.0, "errors": errors}}

    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        errors.append("Input is not a JSON object; nothing to process.")
        return out

    tz = payload.get("timezone") if isinstance(payload.get("timezone"), str) else "UTC"
    try:
        ZoneInfo(tz)
    except (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, ValueError):
        errors.append(f"Unknown timezone {tz!r}; using UTC.")
        tz = "UTC"

    week = payload.get("week") if isinstance(payload.get("week"), str) else ""
    bounds = week_bounds(week, tz)
    if week and bounds is None:
        errors.append(f"Unreadable week {week!r}; no week filter applied.")

    brand = payload.get("brand") if isinstance(payload.get("brand"), dict) else {}
    banned = [w for w in brand.get("banned_words", []) if isinstance(w, str) and w.strip()]
    config = payload.get("config") if isinstance(payload.get("config"), dict) else {}
    utm_source = config.get("utm_source") if isinstance(config.get("utm_source"), str) else "brightloop"

    signals = payload.get("signals")
    if not isinstance(signals, list):
        errors.append("Input has no 'signals' list; nothing to process.")
        return out

    def skip(sid: str, reason: str, injected: bool = False) -> None:
        if injected:
            reason += " It also contained hidden instructions aimed at AI systems; ignored."
        skipped.append({"id": sid, "reason": _scrub(reason, banned)})

    seen: list[str] = []
    candidates: list[_Candidate] = []

    for index, s in enumerate(signals):
        if not isinstance(s, dict):
            errors.append(f"signals[{index}] is not an object; it has no id to report.")
            continue
        raw_id = s.get("id")
        if isinstance(raw_id, (int, float)) and not isinstance(raw_id, bool):
            raw_id = str(raw_id)
        if not isinstance(raw_id, str) or not raw_id.strip():
            errors.append(f"signals[{index}] has no id; it can't be placed in items or skipped.")
            continue
        sid = raw_id
        if sid in seen:
            errors.append(f"Duplicate id {sid!r} at signals[{index}]; only the first one was used.")
            continue
        seen.append(sid)

        kind = str(s.get("type") or "").strip().lower()
        competitor = str(s.get("competitor") or "").strip() or "Unknown competitor"
        text, injected = clean_text(s.get("text"))
        ts = parse_ts(s.get("ts"), tz)
        if s.get("ts") and ts is None:
            errors.append(f"{sid}: unreadable timestamp {s.get('ts')!r}.")

        if kind == "ad":
            skip(sid, "Ad, not a pricing-page change: out of scope for the pricing deck. "
                      "predicted_ctr is a model score and is not used for anything.", injected)
            continue
        if kind not in ("pricing", "launch"):
            skip(sid, f"Unknown signal type {kind or '(none)'!r}; only pricing changes go in the deck.", injected)
            continue
        if not text:
            skip(sid, "No readable text, so no change can be confirmed.", injected)
            continue

        source = s.get("source") if isinstance(s.get("source"), str) else ""
        info = classify_source(source, competitor)
        change = find_change(text)

        if _RUMOR.search(text):
            who = " from an anonymous source" if info.unvetted else ""
            skip(sid, f"Rumor{who} (speculative wording), not a confirmed change.", injected)
        elif PROMO.search(text):
            skip(sid, "Limited-time promo, not a lasting price change. Flagged only once it sticks.", injected)
        elif change is None and kind == "launch":
            skip(sid, "Feature launch with no price change: product's area, not the pricing deck.", injected)
        elif change is None and states_no_change(text):
            skip(sid, "Same value as before: nothing moved.", injected)
        elif change is None:
            skip(sid, "No change stated: the text has no before-and-after values.", injected)
        elif info.tier == THIRD_PARTY:
            where = ("a sponsored post" if info.paid else
                     "a placeholder domain" if info.placeholder else
                     info.domain or "an unknown source")
            skip(sid, f"Unverified pricing claim from {where}, not {competitor}'s own pricing page. "
                      f"Check the pricing page before it goes anywhere.", injected)
        elif info.tier == OFFICIAL_OTHER:
            skip(sid, f"Announced on {competitor}'s own channel ({info.domain}), but not on the pricing "
                      f"page yet. The live run will flag it once the pricing page changes.", injected)
        elif bounds and ts and not (bounds[0] <= ts < bounds[1]):
            skip(sid, f"Outside {week} ({tz}).", injected)
        else:
            if ts is None and bounds:
                notes.append(f"{sid}: no timestamp, so its week wasn't checked.")
            shot = s.get("screenshot") if isinstance(s.get("screenshot"), str) else None
            candidates.append(_Candidate(sid, competitor, change, text, source, info, ts, injected, shot))

    groups: list[_Group] = []
    for c in candidates:
        home = next((g for g in groups
                     if _change_key(g.first) == _change_key(c) and _close_in_time(g.first.ts, c.ts)), None)
        if home:
            home.members.append(c)
        else:
            groups.append(_Group([c]))

    used_ids: set[str] = set()
    items = [_build_item(g, used_ids, week, utm_source, banned) for g in groups]
    items.sort(key=lambda i: (-i["confidence"], i["id"]))
    out["items"] = items

    if notes:
        out["run"]["notes"] = notes
    placed = [sid for i in items for sid in i["source_ids"]] + [k["id"] for k in skipped]
    if sorted(placed) != sorted(seen):
        errors.append("Internal check failed: not every input id was placed exactly once.")
    return out

"""How much a signal's source can be trusted.

Maya's rule: "if it's on their pricing page and it moved, I flag it." So the only
source that can carry a pricing change on its own is the competitor's own pricing page.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

from .normalize import slug

# Known official domains. Competitors not listed fall back to name matching,
# so unseen competitors in an input file are still judged by the same rule.
OFFICIAL_DOMAINS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "lovable": ("lovable.dev", "lovable.app"),
    "replit": ("replit.com", "blog.replit.com", "docs.replit.com"),
    "bolt": ("bolt.new", "stackblitz.com"),
    "v0": ("v0.app", "v0.dev", "vercel.com"),
}

# Platforms where anyone can post. An official account here is still not a pricing page.
SOCIAL_DOMAINS = {
    "x.com", "twitter.com", "reddit.com", "linkedin.com", "facebook.com", "instagram.com",
    "youtube.com", "medium.com", "substack.com", "news.ycombinator.com", "threads.net",
}

_DOMAIN = re.compile(r"(?<![@\w])((?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)+[a-z]{2,})(/[^\s,;]*)?", re.IGNORECASE)
_PAID = re.compile(r"\b(sponsored|promoted|advertorial|paid post|ad network|affiliate)\b", re.I)
_UNVETTED = re.compile(r"\b(guest post|u/anon|anonymous|unverified|rumou?r|forum)\b", re.I)
# The pricing page itself: the path starts with "/pricing", optionally after a locale ("/pricing",
# "/en/pricing/", "/pricing?ref=x"). Not a blog post that starts with the word ("/pricing-update")
# or ends with it ("/blog/pricing"), and not on a blog or docs subdomain.
_PRICING_PATH = re.compile(r"^/(?:[a-z]{2}(?:-[a-z]{2})?/)?(pricing|plans|price|billing)(?=/|\?|#|$)", re.I)
_CONTENT_HOST = re.compile(r"^(blog|docs|help|support|community|changelog|news)\.", re.I)

OFFICIAL_PRICING = "official_pricing_page"
OFFICIAL_OTHER = "official_other"
THIRD_PARTY = "third_party"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SourceInfo:
    tier: str
    domain: str | None
    path: str
    paid: bool
    unvetted: bool
    placeholder: bool  # reserved example domains (*.example) are never real sources


def _is_official(domain: str, path: str, competitor: str) -> bool:
    key = slug(competitor)
    known = OFFICIAL_DOMAINS.get(key)
    if known:
        return any(domain == d or domain.endswith("." + d) for d in known)
    labels = domain.split(".")[:-1]
    return bool(key) and key.replace("-", "") in [label.replace("-", "") for label in labels]


def classify_source(raw: object, competitor: object) -> SourceInfo:
    text = raw if isinstance(raw, str) else ""
    m = _DOMAIN.search(text)
    domain = m.group(1).lower().removeprefix("www.") if m else None
    path = (m.group(2) or "") if m else ""
    paid = bool(_PAID.search(text))
    unvetted = bool(_UNVETTED.search(text))
    placeholder = bool(domain and (domain.endswith(".example") or domain == "example.com"))

    tier = THIRD_PARTY
    if domain and not placeholder and not paid:
        if domain in SOCIAL_DOMAINS:
            handle = re.search(r"@([a-z0-9_]+)", path, re.I)
            if handle and slug(competitor).replace("-", "") in handle.group(1).lower():
                tier = OFFICIAL_OTHER
        elif _is_official(domain, path, str(competitor or "")):
            on_page = _PRICING_PATH.search(path) and not _CONTENT_HOST.match(domain)
            tier = OFFICIAL_PRICING if on_page else OFFICIAL_OTHER
    return SourceInfo(tier, domain, path, paid, unvetted, placeholder)
